title: Updated NDC 3.0 - Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe
organization: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe; submitted to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: Historical flood losses and fisheries impacts; flood-risk estimates to 2050 and 2080
methodology: Government NDC summarizes sector risks, losses and climate projections using cited assessments.
limitations: Several quantified flood and fishery estimates are attributed to external studies, not new NDC analysis.

title: Prosperity for All Saotomeans: Priorities to End Poverty, Promote Growth, and Build Resilience in São Tomé and Príncipe - Systematic Country Diagnostic
temporal_coverage: Historical climate observations from 1951 to 2010 and country diagnostic published in 2021
methodology: World Bank diagnostic synthesizes country and sector evidence; trends draw on the Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal.
limitations: Climate trends are historical and based on polynomial fits; they do not represent updated observations.
